title: The Merchant???
conditions: Requires 100+ Gold OR Foul Potion in inventory
notes: This is a custom merchant event with a visual shop interface rather than standard event options. The merchant sells relics at a fixed price of 50 Gold each. The event's inventory contains 6 randomly selected relics from a pool of 9: [gold]Fake Anchor[/gold], [gold]Fake Blood Vial[/gold], [gold]Fake Happy Flower[/gold], [gold]Fake Lee's Waffle[/gold], [gold]Fake Mango[/gold], [gold]Fake Orichalcum[/gold], [gold]Fake Snecko Eye[/gold], [gold]Fake Strike Dummy[/gold], and [gold]Fake Venerable Tea Set[/gold]. Throwing a [red]Foul Potion[/red] at the merchant triggers combat with the [gold]Fake Merchant Event Encounter[/gold]. All relics that remain unsold after combat are awarded as rewards along with the [gold]Fake Merchant's Rug[/gold] relic.
